hooks.command: set +e; LC_ALL=C; IFS= read -r -d '' data; case "$data" in *'`'*|*u0060*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" || exit 0; printf '%s' "$data" | run_python -I -X utf8 -B "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/bash_quote_guard.py" --block-code=42; [ $? -eq 42 ] && exit 2; exit 0

set +e; LC_ALL=C; IFS= read -r -d '' data; case "$data" in *'`'*|*u0060*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" || exit 0; printf '%s' "$data" | run_python -I -X utf8 -B "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ps_publish_guard.py" --block-code=42; [ $? -eq 42 ] && exit 2; exit 0

set +e; LC_ALL=C; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" && run_python -I -X utf8 -B "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/bash_quote_guard.py" --self-test; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 10 ] || echo "[backtick-check-hook] Check the Bash hook setup (self-test code $rc)."; exit 0
